title: Liberty Broadband Corp 8-K Filing — 2026-04-21
summary: Liberty Broadband Corporation filed an 8-K on April 20, 2026, announcing a quarterly Q&A session for shareholders and analysts following the completion of GCI Liberty Inc.'s first quarter earnings conference call, scheduled for May 7, 2026 at 11:15 a.m. E.T. The filing is submitted under Item 7.01 (Regulation FD Disclosure) and does not contain material non-public information or changes to the company's financial condition.

The filing is furnished under Regulation FD, explicitly stating it shall not be deemed 'filed' for any purpose.
The company is registered in Delaware (Commission File Number: 001-36713).
